stem.en: A student writes: "The ozone hole lets extra heat in, and this is the main cause of global warming." What is wrong with this?

text.en: Ozone stops ultraviolet; greenhouse gases hold heat

feedback.en: Yes. They are two different problems.

text.en: There is no ozone anywhere in the air

feedback.en: No. Ozone is found in the stratosphere.

text.en: The ozone hole lies right over India

feedback.en: No. The thinning is over Antarctica.

text.en: Ozone is the main gas of all in the air

feedback.en: No. Nitrogen is the main gas.

explanation.en: Ozone takes in ultraviolet rays, so a thinner layer lets more ultraviolet through. Warming comes mainly from greenhouse gases added by human activity, which hold heat rising from the ground.

hints.en: What kind of ray does ozone take in?
